@@U03914@@
There! There! Oh, let me fly! I must! 1 must! (He hurls himself into the air, his clothes bear him up for a moment, his head shines with a radiance, and a trail of light follows him.)

@@U03916@@
伊卡洛斯! 伊卡洛斯! O sorrowful sight! (A beautiful youth falls dead at his parents feet; we appear to recognize the face as that of a familiar figure; but the body vanishes immediately, the radiance rises skyward like a comet, while his robe, cloak, and lyre remain on the ground.) 海伦 and 浮士德: How swiftly joy is turned to pain.

@@U03918@@
Mother, don’t leave me alone in darkness!

@@U03919@@
(Pause.)

@@U03921@@
(Threnody.)

@@U03922@@
Not alone! No matter where you Dwell we still will claim to know you; And even though from day you vanish, Our faithful hearts will not forego you. How ever can our hearts lament you, When we must envy you your fate? For your song in joy or sadness, Like your soul, was fair and great. Born to earthly fortune, rarely Gifted, blest with noble name, All too soon, alas! departed,
translation:
@@U03914@@
在那里！那里！哦，让我飞吧！我必须！ 1必须！ （他跳到空中，衣服支撑了他一会儿，他的头闪闪发亮，一道光迹跟随他。）

@@U03916@@
伊卡洛斯！ 伊卡洛斯！哦，悲伤的景象！ （美少年倒在父母脚下，我们似乎认出那张脸是熟悉的身影，但尸体立刻消失，光辉如彗星般升上天空，而他的袍子、斗篷和琴留在地上。） 海伦和浮士德：快乐多么迅速地变成了痛苦。

@@U03918@@
妈妈，别把我一个人留在黑暗里！

@@U03919@@
（停顿。）

@@U03921@@
（挽歌。）

@@U03922@@
并不孤单！无论您住在哪里，我们仍然会声称认识您；即使从那天起你就消失了，我们忠实的心也不会放弃你。当我们不得不羡慕你的命运时，我们的心怎能哀叹你呢？因为你的歌声无论欢乐还是悲伤，就像你的灵魂一样，美丽而伟大。出生于尘世的财富，很少有天赋，拥有高贵的名字，可惜一切都太快了！离开了，
